maddeler.e:
يتجافى (form VI)
# يَتَجَافَى (yatajāfā) /ja.ta.d͡ʒaː.faː/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative/subjunctive of تَجَافَى (tajāfā)
# يُتَجَافَى (yutajāfā) /ju.ta.d͡ʒaː.faː/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative/subjunctive of تَجَافَى (tajāfā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
